cosmic_data.attached_dimention_id.help: The namespace:name of the dimension this file applies to
cosmic_data.gui_data.travel_dimension.he: The dimension players will teleport to on travelling here from a GUI. Usually same as attached_dimension_id
cosmic_data.gui_data.origin_x.help: The x coordinate players are taken to when travelling here from a GUI
cosmic_data.gui_data.unlocking_dimension: The dimension that unlocks travel to here from a GUI. Usually a previous solar system
cosmic_data.gui_data.background.help: The filename of the image used for the background
cosmic_data.gui_data.order.help: Determines what order this dimension is in the GUI
cosmic_data.gui_data.object_data.travel_: The x coordinate players are taken to when fast travelling to this planet. Should NOT be inside the planet, usually is nearby
cosmic_data.gui_data.object_data.unlocki: The dimension that unlocks fast travel to this planet. Usually the dimension of the planet
cosmic_data.gui_data.object_data.life.he: The percent chance of life on this planet. GUI ONLY, does not affect spawn rates
cosmos.atmo_data.atmosphere_y.help: Height at which players are taken to space
cosmos.atmo_data.travel_to.help: The namespace:name of the dimension players are taken to
cosmos.atmo_data.origin_x.help: The x coordinate players are taken to in space (commonly above the planet in orbit)
cosmos.atmo_data.overlay_texture_id.help: The progressbar texture shown when in space nodule. Needs to be 16x128
cosmos.atmo_data.shipbit_y.help: The bottom height the rocket should get to on the progressbar
cosmos.atmo_data.ship_min_y.help: The y value at which the rocket will be at its lowest on the progressbar
cosmos.sky_data.object_yaw.help: The yaw rotation of this object in the sky
cosmos.sky_data.yaw.help: The initial yaw around its parent planet this object will start at
cosmos.sky_data.yaw_speed.help: The yaw speed around its parent planet this object rotates at
cosmos.planet_data.opaque.help: Whether this planet is affected by sunlight
cosmos.planet_data.inverse_texture_id.he: The texture shown on the 'darkside' of the planet
cosmos.planet_data.cloud_data.animation_: The folder where animation frames are stored. Must end in a '/' to signify folder. Frames MUST be named '1.png' '2.png' etc
cosmos.sky_data.cloud_data.animation_fol: The folder where animation frames are stored. Must end in a '/' to signify folder. Frames MUST be named '1.png' '2.png' etc
cosmos.planet_data.cloud_data.cloud_colo: The color overlay put onto the cloud animation frames
cosmos.sky_data.cloud_data.cloud_color.h: The color overlay put onto the cloud animation frames
cosmos.planet_data.model_type.help: If an object is a blackhole, texture_id (and some other data) is ignored
cosmos.planet_data.object_name.help: I don't know what this is for, but its used in default CH files
cosmos.planet_data.model_data.step.help: The quality of the rings. Recommended is 3 < x < 10
cosmos.planet_data.model_data.speed.help: The speed at which the disk rotates
valkyrienskies.list_node.entry.mass.help: The weight of the block in kg
valkyrienskies.list_node.entry.elasticit: The 'Bounciness' of the block. Default is 0.3, slime is 1.0
valkyrienskies.list_node.entry.no_collis: If set to true, forces the block to not collide with/on a VS ship. Used for things like leaves
Default is 100, you may need higher to override default values or other packs
valkyrienskies.vs_dimension_parameters.d: Must be formatted as 'minecraft:dimension:yournamespace:yourdimension'. For example, minecraft:dimension:minecraft:overworld
valkyrienskies.vs_dimension_parameters.m: The maxiumum height at which there is atmosphere. Set to -1 for no atmosphere at all
valkyrienskies.vs_dimension_parameters.s: The maximum height at which the atmosphere is full-strength. Ignored if maxYPos is -1
valkyrienskies.vs_dimension_parameters.g: The x, y and z force applied to ships as gravity
valkyrienskies.vs_dimension_parameters.p: The priority to override other packs. VS uses a priority of -1
valkyrienskies.vs_entities.handler.help: Default: entity moved to world. Shipyard: entity stays on ship. NOTE: Save this file as entitynamespace:entity, or it WILL NOT WORK. For example, immersive_paintings:painting
ad_astra.planets.dimension.help: The dimension id of the planet, in the form namespace:name
ad_astra.planets.gravity.help: Due to floating point precision, the actual gravity may be slightly off in-game
ad_astra.planets.orbit.help: The orbit dimension id. If left blank, this planet is treated as an orbit dimension
ad_astra.planets.solar_system.help: Controls where the planet will be on the selector screen
ad_astra.planets.temperature.help: Below -50 will freeze, above 70 will burn
ad_astra.planets.tier.help: The minimum rocket tier required to reach this planet
ad_astra.planets.additional_launch_dimen: Additional dimensions that the player can launch from
